audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-tempo, upbeat pop/electronic instrumental featuring a bright synth melody and a strong, rhythmic beat. No vocals are present during this initial branding sequence. (2) A friendly, energetic female voice begins narrating with a mid-high pitch and high arousal level. She speaks at a fast pace with a professional yet animated tone, perfectly synchronized with the fast-cut visuals. (3) A series of intentional post-production sound effects, including digital "pops" and "whooshes," accompany the appearance of on-screen text and scene transitions. The music maintains a constant, high-energy presence in the background. (4) Sharp, short-bandwidth "clicks" and "clacks" are heard as the woman interacts with the makeup products and gashapon dial, adding a layer of tactile realism to the edited mix. (5) A digital "ding" sounds when the color testing kiosk is used, followed by the mechanical rumble of a plastic capsule rolling down a chute. The narrator's vocal clarity is high and well-defined. (6) During the photo booth segment, a classic "camera shutter" sound effect is used to punctuate the poses, while the music volume swells slightly for emphasis before the final speech segment. (7) The video ends with a closing statement from the narrator, delivered with a positive, rising intonation, as the music reaches a final peak and then abruptly cuts to silence.
